LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Mexico

Visitors need an individual permit for recreational fishing from a boat or underwater. Shore fishing has a permit exemption, but catch limits and closed seasons still apply.

  • 1 dayMXN 204
  • 7 daysMXN 510
  • 1 monthMXN 766
  • 1 yearMXN 1021
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Rules for this water

  • The general marine daily limit is ten fish, with at most five of one species; special species equivalents apply.
  • Check the official rules for Isla Blanca, including water exceptions and current closures official regulations ↗
